changes.description: A magnifier over the pin editor's map: a glass following the cursor that shows the basemap enlarged without moving the map, so siting a pin no longer means zooming in and out to read which river, which road, which workings. It takes no pointer events, so a click under it still places a pin, and it stops at the depth the provider's tiles go to rather than magnifying blur. Raster basemaps only, which is all the pin editor offers: a vector style is drawn by MapLibre GL inside Leaflet and magnifying one would mean a second WebGL context. With the basemap off the control says there are no tiles to magnify.
